LanguageData.MF_ProjectorFilmAfterNight: An ongoing memory night keeps the film chosen when it started. Films selected here play after the gathering ends.
LanguageData.MF_ProjectorOpenAlbumDesc: Open the currently projected photograph in the album. Use ‘Projection size’ to change its size on the map.
LanguageData.MF_ProjectorNightWhen: You can start a gathering at any time of day. The film needs at least {0} photographs and available colonists. Only one memory night can run on the same map at a time.
LanguageData.MF_ProjectionCustomHelp: {0}–{1} cells per side; decimals allowed. Photographs retain their proportions within this area. Resizing the projection does not change the source image or its resolution.
LanguageData.MF_ProjectionInvalid: Enter valid width and height values within the allowed range.
LanguageData.MF_ProjectionOffMap: The projection area extends beyond the map. Reduce its size or move the projector.
LanguageData.MF_ProjectionCustomReady: Applying also updates the area preview and memory-night audience positions.
LanguageData.MF_ProjectionDepthHelp: Display the photograph behind objects like a floor, or in front of items, furniture and pawns. Does not change menus or windows.
